---
name: Bug report
about: Report a reproducible problem in the skill or offline tools.
---

## What happened

Describe the problem and the result you expected.

## Reproduce it

Include the command or minimal agent request, a synthetic input and the relevant error output.

## Environment

Give the commit or release, operating system and Python version. For an agent workflow, name the host and model.

Remove credentials, private project data and media from the report. Use the private reporting route in SECURITY.md for security issues.
